body:
WHAT
In OVERDRIVE, the first time a turn that made at least one tool call tries to end cleanly, the engine injects a hidden self-check message asking the model whether the user's query is fully handled and nothing unnecessary was left behind. The model's reply is buffered, not streamed: if it is only the word DONE (possibly decorated), the turn ends and the user sees just the original reply; anything else is revealed and the turn continues. It fires once per turn and is re-armed by mid-run steering.

WHY
Autonomous runs have no user checkpoint, so an unverified 'I think I'm done' is expensive; streaming the DONE token or firing the rung every attempt would spam the chat and multiply round trips.

WHERE
engine/core/src/runtime/finishing.ts — selfVerifyText(changedCode) (returns undefined when the prompt is disabled), SELF_VERIFY, SELF_VERIFY_CLOSING_CODE, SELF_VERIFY_CLOSING_PLAIN, codeFilesAmong(). engine/core/src/runtime/session.ts — isSelfVerifyDone(text); Session.runTurn(): selfVerifyFired / verifyBuffered flags, the `const verify = stopReason === 'end_turn' && !selfVerifyFired && totalToolCallsThisTurn > 0 && this.overdrive ? selfVerifyText(…) : undefined` rung, this.suppressAssistantText, the verifyBuffered handling after streamAssistantTurn (DONE → break with one visible reply; else emit buffered text_delta), drainSteering() resets selfVerifyFired.

TEST CHECKLIST
1. isSelfVerifyDone accepts 'DONE', '**DONE**', 'DONE.', 'DONE DONE', 'done!' and rejects '', 'No', 'DONE but also fixed x', and a localized word like 'Bitti'.
2. In OVERDRIVE with a FakeProvider scripted [tool call, 'Finished the fix.', 'DONE'], the third request's last user message contains 'Internal self-check' and the user-visible text_delta events contain 'Finished the fix.' but never 'DONE'; turn_finished fires with stopReason 'end_turn' after exactly three requests.
3. When the self-verify reply is 'Also updating the README' plus a tool call, that text IS emitted as text_delta and the loop continues with the tool call.
4. A turn with zero tool calls in OVERDRIVE ends after one request with no self-check message; a turn with tool calls but overdrive off also never receives the self-check.
5. The rung fires once: after a DONE, if the model somehow continues (e.g. Stop hook blocks), no second 'Internal self-check' message is sent unless steer() was called in between.
6. selfVerifyText(['a.ts']) contains the 'You changed code this turn (a.ts)' closing; selfVerifyText([]) contains 'never invent verification rituals'; when the self-verify prompt is disabled in the registry it returns undefined and no extra request is made.
